title: The model plugin of Llama, Qwen2 and Qwen3 checkpoints and their mixtures of experts
description: A pre-norm decoder of grouped-query softmax attention (rotary positions, query/key norms and biases where stored, sliding-window layers where the config's layer_types name them) and a SwiGLU MLP, or a mixture of experts on the layers the config routes (a shared expert and its gate where stored). A finished model plugin: its layout (layout.json) composed by the models core it extends (model-template: the serving contracts, the options) from model techniques.
